scenario_usage.id: T021-150-154 (ncs-*) - real _struct_ncs_oper rows, extracted and run directly through the pure NCS guard
scenario_usage.note_honest_limitation: Full end-to-end materialize_receptor_cif021() of this deposition, selecting chain A only (dispositioning the three ZN ions and nine water asyms to 'remove'), does NOT reach a successful plan: a separate, unrelated real struct_conn row (metalc2, A-D, ptnr1_symmetry='3_675') requires resolving a true crystallographic symmetry operator this profile has no _symmetry_equiv/_space_group_symop table to prove, and correctly raises UNSUPPORTED_SYMMETRY - this is itself a genuine, honestly-reported finding about this specific real deposition's crystallography (a real metal coordination to a symmetry-related copy), not a defect in the NCS handling and not worked around. The two real _struct_ncs_oper rows (id 1/2, both code='given', confirmed non-identity-irrelevant per the frozen rule 'given' never requires an identity check) are therefore exercised directly: extracted verbatim from the real deposition and run through compute_category_decisions()/the pure NCS guard in isolation, proving the guard against genuine deposited operator values rather than a hand-written matrix.
scenario_usage.expected_outcome_ncs_guard: _struct_ncs_oper category decision action='guard_then_omit', both real rows omitted-audited, no UNSUPPORTED_NCS/INVALID_CIF raised for either (both code='given', values taken verbatim from the deposition).
